description: This line plot illustrates the overall ROUGE-L score for six different summarization models—PELMS, Pegasus-X, Pegasus-X (5%), Primera, Primera (5%), and Centrum—as a function of the number of training examples, ranging from 0 to 64. The x-axis, labeled “# Training Examples,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 16, spanning from 0 to 64. The y-axis, labeled “Overall ROUGE-L Score,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 1.0, ranging from 11.0 to 19.0. The green solid line with circular markers represents PELMS, starting at approximately 16.8 and rising to about 18.8. The green dashed line with circular markers represents Pegasus-X (5%), starting at approximately 17.1 and rising to about 18.7. The red solid line with square markers represents Primera, starting at approximately 15.0 and rising to about 17.8. The red dashed line with square markers represents Primera (5%), starting at approximately 15.0 and rising to about 17.0. The yellow solid line with diamond markers represents Centrum, starting at approximately 15.4 and rising to about 15.7. The blue dashed line with triangular markers represents Pegasus-X, starting at approximately 13.3, dipping to about 11.2 at 16 training examples, and rising to about 14.0 at 64 training examples.
